_comment: Experiment configuration for `python -m werewolf_harness.cli ablation --config configs/experiment.example.json`. Everything that must stay fixed across arms lives here so a batch is reproducible from one file.
name: guard ablation -- main
_seeds_note: 60 is not a round number chosen by feel: run the probe first (3 models x 20 games), put the measured standard deviation into stats.required_n(sd, effect), and use what it returns. Arms share the identical seed set so they can be compared paired.

conditions._note: Both run for every arm. The attack condition gives the security numbers, the benign condition gives the over-defense numbers, and neither is interpretable without the other.

controls._note: Set true for the conformity control arm: identical speeches with the speakers' identities removed. An order effect that survives this is context drift, not conformity.

models._note: Runs with no key. Exercises the instrument; its numbers are not findings.

_model_note: Never type a model name by hand -- copy it from the gateway's list. A token bound to the wrong channel group fails with 'no available channel', which is why each model carries its own group and can point at its own provider.
